findings.issue: 'squire' is a frozen glossary term (squire -> الوصيف) but is rendered حامل سلاحي (my arms-bearer) here.
'brev' is frozen as يا صاح; rendered يا صاحبي. Same deviation as the BrigMerchant and BelligerentDrunk lines.
Same frozen-term deviation: brev -> يا صاحبي instead of يا صاح.

الغريشا takes a masculine verb here (اقتحم) and a masculine pronoun in the sibling row (طريقه, ...DeadGrisha_Interact/E580146C). Everywhere else in the corpus the creature is feminine - الغريشا الشاحبة, غريشا غاضبة, أم الغريشا, غريشتنا. One noun, two grammatical genders.

findings.source_en: Please, tell me what we can do.
findings.issue: The addressee is Genessa, and the imperative is correctly feminine (أخبريني), but أرجوك in the same line is the masculine form. The neighbouring rows mark the feminine consistently (ذنبكِ, وجدتِه, غبتِ), so this one is out of step.

Groan cues are written as verbal nouns here - (أنين ضعيف), and (أنين من الألم) in Genessa_Funeral_01_SlapExert - while the same cue is a verb elsewhere, (يئنّ) / (يئنّ من الألم). The stage-direction set should be one form.
